scope: Typed learning outbox delivery projection and explicit scoped retry

tests.command: flutter test --no-pub test/learning_delivery_outbox_test.dart test/sqlite_learning_outbox_test.dart test/learning_event_queue_test.dart test/learning_event_sync_service_test.dart test/learning_event_sync_lifecycle_test.dart test/learning_activity_tracker_test.dart test/media_learning_event_test.dart --reporter expanded

verified_behaviors: Owner/API filter before body decoding; cohort/version/course and pedagogical type selection
Scoped blocked retry verifies immutable body inside the SQLite transaction without JSON1
Typed data/storage/import-cleanup errors; OutboxConflict stays explicit
Known synchronous/asynchronous open failures do not permanently poison the cached Future
Account/environment/context isolation; immutable retry/reopen; no recursive notification on reads
limitations: Controller and widget acceptance are separate
No schema migration, API change, production promotion or release build
Storage import-cleanup exception is typed but native SharedPreferences cleanup failure is not injected by these eight new tests
